# Aadesh Gurav

> Software engineer building systems below the application layer — storage engines, process orchestration, and infrastructure other software depends on. Based in Ratnagiri, Maharashtra, India.

Aadesh works mostly in Python and Rust, with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms for production deployment. Recent work spans a document database built from scratch in Rust, an autonomous AI operating system that boots as PID 1 on Alpine Linux, and a proof-of-concept that routes data between MongoDB and Neo4j behind a single adapter contract.

This site (aadeshgurav.online) is a personal portfolio with 8 selectable visual themes (Terminal, Glassmorphism Night, Apple Liquid Glass, Flat Minimal, Cyberpunk, Swiss Editorial, Neubrutalist, Bento Dashboard) — the content is identical across themes, only the presentation differs.

## Projects

- JARVIS — a bare-metal autonomous AI operating system that boots as PID 1 on Alpine Linux. https://github.com/AadeshGurav/JARVIS
- NebulaDB — a document database built from scratch in Rust, with a custom storage engine and query layer. https://github.com/AadeshGurav/NebulaDB
- polystore — a Frappe proof-of-concept that routes each DocType to MongoDB or Neo4j behind one adapter contract. https://github.com/AadeshGurav/polystore
- OptiFlow — a WhatsApp-integrated appointment and patient management system with real-time people-counting. https://github.com/AadeshGurav/OptiFlow
- tiffin — a unit-based meal coupon system for a school canteen, piloted on a single campus. https://github.com/AadeshGurav/tiffin
